scope: GitHub metric attribution correction; no new case discovery or repository-star refresh

policy.pull_request: Own issue-body reactions.total_count; compared with PRs only
policy.issue: Own issue-body reactions.total_count; compared with issues only
policy.comments: Own discussion comments count displayed, excludes inline review comments; never used for ranking
policy.fileGistOther: No independent supported metric; unranked; never inherit parent stars
policy.ranking: Midrank percentile in each source/metric/object-kind cohort; equal values tie; zero = 0; missing = -1; positive singleton = 0.5
policy.reactionsMeaning: Includes all reaction types, including negative or eyes reactions; not a measure of approvals or quality
policy.failure: Retain own-object metrics only when metricsSourceUrl matches the exact API object; legacy parent stars are removed even on failure
